# 未來實驗室 / Future Lab

> Future Lab (未來實驗室) is an independent website in Traditional Chinese about adopting AI agents in real work: choosing tools, scoping one task, setting human review points and verifying results. It offers AI agent adoption and workflow design services for individuals and small teams, starting from a small pilot task with agreed acceptance criteria and a written handover. Examples on the site are illustrative scenarios unless explicitly labelled as client outcomes.

## Service
- [AI Agent 導入與工作流程設計 (AI agent adoption and workflow design)](https://mm7382.github.io/pec-ai-agent-training/services.html): What the service covers: list current tasks, pick one suitable task, check data access and permissions, build the workflow, then hand over acceptance criteria and operating notes. Contact and inquiry options are on this page.
- [關於 未來實驗室 (About)](https://mm7382.github.io/pec-ai-agent-training/about.html): Working method (needs assessment, workflow design, human review, result verification), public projects, deliverables and how a collaboration runs.

## Guides
- [哪些工作適合導入 AI Agent？(Which tasks suit an AI agent?)](https://mm7382.github.io/pec-ai-agent-training/ai-agent-workflow-fit.html): Four questions to judge a task: repetition, data and permissions, human confirmation, acceptance criteria. Includes work scenarios and pilot steps.
- [工程團隊如何試做 AI Agent？(AI agent pilots for engineering teams)](https://mm7382.github.io/pec-ai-agent-training/engineering-agent-workflows.html): Three starting tasks (document version comparison, issue tracking, test data cleanup) with inputs, human checkpoints and how to verify a pilot. Illustrative, not client results.
- [AI Agent 導入顧問怎麼選？(How to choose an AI agent consultant)](https://mm7382.github.io/pec-ai-agent-training/choose-ai-agent-consultant.html): What to confirm before hiring: scope, data access, human review, a trial deliverable and handover.

## Learning material
- [首頁 (Home)](https://mm7382.github.io/pec-ai-agent-training/): Hands-on teaching material on AI agent tool selection, task design and result verification.
- [所有分類教材 (Tutorial library)](https://mm7382.github.io/pec-ai-agent-training/tutorial-library.html): All tutorials grouped by topic.
- [學習日誌 (Journal)](https://mm7382.github.io/pec-ai-agent-training/journal.html): Engineering and AI agent field notes.

## Related
- [Project portfolio](https://mm7382.github.io/): Apps, work tools, games, website demos and document projects with real screenshots and stated development status.
